text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Textured Stoneware Planter, 6.25"H, Ivory
Colors: Ivory
Materials: stoneware
With its stylish woven pattern, this ivory-glazed pot will set off any kind of plant or flower arrangement, whether indoors or out. Use it as a coffee-table centerpiece, or set it on the steps outside your home for a welcoming touch. 6.75" diameter x 6.25"H; 5.875" interior diameter Made from 100% stoneware for long-lasting durability With a drainage hole in the bottom, this pot is perfect for direct or indirect planting. Woven pattern on the pot's exterior adds dimensional interest. No assembly required Hand wash with a damp cloth.
